english.title: Premises owner or occupier cause water fitting to be such that water supplied is likely to be wasted
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner or occupier of premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) to which a supply of water was provided by a water

(A)_[undertaker,]_
(B)_[supply licensee,]_

intentionally or negligently caused or suffered a water fitting, namely **(..SPECIFY WATER FITTING..), for which you were responsible to be or remain so out of order, so in need of repair or so constructed or adapted, or to be so used that the water so supplied was or was likely to be

(C)_[wasted]_
(D)_[, having regard to the purpose for which it was supplied, misused or unduly consumed]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 73(1)(c) of the Water Industry Act 1991
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the owner or occupier of premises
to which a supply of water was provided by a water undertaker or licensed water supplier
intentionally or negligently caused or suffered a water fitting for which you were responsible to be or remain
so out of order, so in need of repair or so constructed or adapted, or to be so used
that water so supplied was or was likely to be wasted or,
having regard to the purposes for which it was supplied, misused or unduly consumed
